stackRetention.title: Stack history
stackRetention.caption: How many revisions Coaming keeps for each stack.
stackRetention.label: Revisions kept per stack
stackRetention.helper: The deployed revision and the last good one are always kept, even when older. Older revisions are deleted, along with their variables and secret files.
stackRetention.error: Use a whole number from 5 to 200.
stackRetention.loadFailed: Couldn't load the stack history setting.
stackRetention.note: Coaming keeps the last {{count, number}} revisions of each stack. The deployed revision and the last good one are always kept. Older revisions are deleted, along with their variables and secret files.

confirm.title: Delete older revisions?
confirm.body: Lowering this to {{keep, number}} deletes {{revisions}} across {{stacks}}. They can't be recovered.
confirm.bodyUnknown: Older revisions are deleted the next time pruning runs. They can't be recovered.
